currentHint: Uses current save health & weapon level
customHint: Custom max health & weapon upgrade level
actionFailed: Action failed. Retry or end practice.
stagePreviewHint: Full stage growth is not implemented. Copy weapons and levels to Custom for Normal, first-cycle practice; current growth and soul unlocks remain.
stageMissingHint: No stage preset for this fight yet. Use Custom to practice with your current equipment.
adaptiveUnavailableHint: Adaptive difficulty is not available yet. Use Custom to retain the current difficulty.
perSlotCustomHint: Edit owned weapons per slot; current growth, accessories, medicines and soul unlocks remain. Boss and difficulty controls are below.
loadoutNotReady: Waiting for player equipment. Select Use current equipment to refresh.
stageCopyUnavailable: Preview only. Copying requires every listed weapon to be owned and within its level cap.
copiedStageHint: Draft weapons and levels copied. Current growth, accessories, medicines and soul unlocks remain; this is not a first-encounter character.
bossHint: Applies to new practice and persists on reset. Difficulty uses native rules; attack scaling affects health and Sha-Chi attack attributes.
practiceHint: Stay out of combat and change equipment freely. Configure each numbered target independently. Targets recover from hits, then return to their own pose; converted enemies may attack their peers. Equipment changes start a new sample.
targetControllable: Ordinary enemy: test lute conversion after a guard break.
targetNotControllable: Elite enemy: native rules prevent lute conversion.
targetLiveHint: Changes affect only the selected target and wait until recovery or conversion ends. Type or placement changes respawn that target. Reset keeps every target's current configuration.
targetDraftHint: Edit the next session without changing the current one. Apply by starting a new session.
targetEditFailed: Target edit was not applied; the previous settings were kept. Check that the position has walkable ground.
startMenuSubtitle: Isolated sandbox · Saves and achievements untouched
highCycleHint: Cycle 8 maxed template (all weapons Lv.60 · accessories +6 · max nodes); customize slots, cycle, and scales below, or swap accessories in-world.
highCycleOverrideHint: Imported external template active; customize unlocked weapons, cycle, and scales below.
noPersonalSaveHint: No in-world character loaded; customizing from the Cycle 8 template.
targetingFanHint: Five dummies: check initial lock, scroll order and stick switching.
targetingDepthHint: Four dummies: two overlap front to back, with one on each side. Check crosshair selection and switching.
targetingMixedHint: Three dummies and two explosive barrels. Switch between enemies and environmental targets.
targetingBarrelFrontHint: One barrel in front of the centre dummy, plus two side dummies. Check barrel selection and lock release after detonation.
targetingFlow: Choose a preset → Start → Reset and repeat.
targetingDraftRule: Presets change the next round. Continue and reset keep the current round. Reset restores destroyed barrels.
targetingCustomHint: Expand to adjust dummies. A preset replaces the next round’s dummies and barrels.
skillEditingHint: This round · Right-click a node to refund one rank
skillRefundLimit: Refund would exceed the resource limit.
skillUndoExpired: Skills or resources changed; undo is no longer available.
skillEditFailed: Skill edit failed. End practice and re-enter before editing again.
